title: Adventure Watersports

Snorkeling at manmade reefs near Peanut Island with diverse fish and underwater life
Private boat charters visit Peanut Island and other scenic spots
Parasailing age limits: 6-18 with guardian permission, 18+ can sign for themselves

services.name: Parasailing Adventure
services.desc: Breathtaking views of Singer Island, Palm Beach Island, and the Atlantic Ocean. Please arrive at marina 30 MINUTES EARLY to our kiosk on the beach for check-in. No Refunds for no-shows or late

variants.label: Private boat rental with captain for sightseeing, snorkeling, or happy hour tours
Wakeboarding and water skiing lessons and rides in Intracoastal Waterway or offshore

includes: Snorkel and mask included in snorkeling tour
Captain and crew for private boat charters
Life jackets and proper equipment for wakeboarding and water skiing
gap: Prices not stated for any offerings
blurb: Guests can parasail over the Atlantic Ocean, snorkel at reefs near Peanut Island, enjoy private boat charters with a captain, and try wakeboarding or water skiing in the Intracoastal Waterway or offshore. Parasailing flights last about an hour to an hour and a half. Private boat charters accommodate up to six guests and can be customized for snorkeling, sightseeing, or happy hour cruises.
extraNote: Arrive 30 minutes prior to scheduled time · Parasailing safety monitored with weather checks · Private boat charters limited to 6 passengers per trip for safety · Captain makes final decisions on safety and conditions · No-shows/late-arrivals will lose their opportunity to rebook and will not receive a refund for the activities purchased. · If a trip is cancelled due to weather/ocean conditions, a gift card for the full purchase amount will be issued. · Riviera Beach Marina, directly across from Peanut Island
